reason: My cousin in India already handles my bank paperwork and moves money for me for nothing, so paying a company a few hundred dollars feels unnecessary. I'm also not comfortable with an unknown firm moving my pension savings.
objection: My relative can sort this out for free, and I've never heard of this company. Why pay CAD $199 when family does it for the price of a thank-you?
would_change_my_mind: If my relative was unavailable or the bank rejected the paperwork, and someone I know in Canada had used them safely, I might try the lowest tier.
